when.quote: Procedure for when a customer wants to close, cancel, or deactivate their debit card.

starts.note: The agent recommends closing when the customer confirms a card is lost or stolen, and proposes it when the PIN-lock protocol finds unauthorized transactions. A card is closed only when the customer asks or agrees.
starts.quote: If customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, recommend closing instead of freezing

tools.not_used: Freezing is for misplaced cards (freezing_and_unfreezing_a_debit_card). A card confirmed lost or stolen is closed instead.
The replacement is ordered in order_replacement_debit_card (k8).
Used in the cross-product protocol, which cross_product_handoff starts.
Doc 005 is cited only for its tier list. No account is closed here.

steps.do:
Check eligibility for each card.
(1) The card's user_id matches the verified user.
(2) Its status is ACTIVE or PENDING. If it is FROZEN, ask k6_ask. A CLOSED card cannot be closed again.
(3) The card has no pending or processing transactions. Read k3 for entries with status 'pending'. The lookup reads the whole account and has no card field, so if pending entries exist, ask the customer whether they were made with this card.
(4) There are no pending refunds. No lookup reads refunds to a card, so ask the customer whether they expect one.
(5) Card age, from cl_age. This check is skipped for lost, stolen and fraud_suspected.
If a check fails, tell the customer what must be resolved and do not close that card. Pending transactions: wait for all transactions to settle. Pending refunds: wait for them to process (typically 3-5 business days), or acknowledge in writing that the refunds will be credited to the linked checking account.
steps.quote: 3. Check eligibility requirements. If any requirement is not met, inform the customer what needs to be resolved and do not proceed with closure.

If pending refunds exist, inform the customer they must wait for the refunds to process (typically 3-5 business days) or acknowledge in writing that the refunds will be credited to the linked checking account instead.

For fraud_suspected, also advise them to review recent transactions, file disputes for any unauthorized charges, and change their online banking password.

steps.do: Confirm the card is permanently deactivated and cannot be reactivated. Remind the customer that recurring payments on it must be updated with new payment information, and that a new card is ordered through the standard ordering process. If the customer wants a replacement, go to order_replacement_debit_card.
